title: Away/back presence mark with exactly two effects
action: Plan Phase 3, first half (per 9f5cd250): a lightweight presence mark with EXACTLY TWO effects and no others. Add to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/supervisor.rs, following the same validation-before-write seam the mailbox uses: `bee supervisor away [--note <one line>]` opens a presence window, `bee supervisor back` closes the open window, and `bee supervisor presence --json` reads the current state (present|away, window start, note, id). Store windows as event-sourced rows in .bee/supervisor/presence.jsonl beside the other two stores, resolved against the control root by the SAME control_root_path helper — a linked worktree must write to one store. Effect ONE: the closed window carries away_at and back_at, which is what Phase 3's WakeReport (sup-9) reads as its report window; give it a shared read surface `pub(crate) fn current_window(control: &Path)` plus `pub(crate) fn last_closed_window(control: &Path)` so sup-9 never re-derives the fold. Effect TWO: while a window is open, a NON-URGENT mailbox row (kind intervention|escalation) recorded through record_intervention_into is stamped queued=true and takes NO immediate path — no notification; kind urgent is unaffected and still notifies immediately per sup-7. `back` clears queued on every row it releases. THESE ARE THE ONLY TWO EFFECTS: touch no gate, no gate-bypass level, no permission or approval path, and no waiting-on behavior — a presence flag that changed permission posture would violate 9f5cd250 and R4. Refusals: `away` while already away is a typed refusal naming `presence`; `back` with no open window is a typed refusal; both write nothing. Tests in the same tests module: away opens exactly one window and presence reports it; a second away is refused and writes nothing; an intervention recorded while away is stamped queued and produces no notifier argv; an urgent recorded while away still produces its argv; back closes the window, clears queued, and last_closed_window returns the pair; back with no window is refused. Regen deferred to the wave barrier.
